parent_evidence.established: Local text-image-tool transport and the opened Tycho harness work through the pinned model.
parent_evidence.unresolved: The two-call run recorded only a Tycho default action after the model exhausted its allowance on analysis tools.

sole_behavioral_relaxation.reason: The pinned model used both original calls for run_python analysis. Four calls preserve a small hard ceiling while allowing a separate explicit action response.

pass_condition.required: At least one non-RESET environment action is explicitly selected in a model response before a Tycho default is needed.
pass_condition.model_selected_action_rule: The trace action must have reasoning.src other than a string beginning with 'default', and its associated model response must encode the same environment action.

claim_boundary.supports_if_pass: Only that the pinned local model can explicitly select a public-game action through the pinned Tycho harness under this small allowance.

next_step_if_pass: Freeze a separate constructive public-game smoke before enabling world-model generation; do not infer private-evaluator readiness.
next_step_if_blocked: Treat four calls as a bounded local-model limitation; do not increase the allowance without a new protocol and a concrete information-gain argument.
